sn5.3:1.2: Atha kho Kisā-Gotamī bhikkhunī pubbaṇhasamayaṃ nivāsetva pattacīvaram ādāya Sāvatthim piṇḍāya pāvisi || || 2.
sn5.3:1.3: Sāvatthiyaṃ piṇḍāya caritvā pacchābhattaṃ piṇḍapāta- paṭikkantā yena andhavanaṃ ten-upasaṅkami divāvihārāya ||
sn5.3:1.4: andhavanaṃ ajjhogahetvā aññatarasmiṃ rukkhamūle divāvihāraṃ nisīdi || || 3.
sn5.3:1.5: Atha kho Māro pāpimā Kisā-Gotamiyā bhikkhuniyā bhayaṃ chambhitattaṃ lomahaṃsaṃ uppādetu-kāmo samādimhā cāvetu-kāmo yena Kisā-Gotamī bhikkhunī ten-upasaṅkami || || Upasaṅkamitvā Kisā-Gotamī bhikkhuniṃ gāthāya ajjhabhāsi || ||
sn5.3:3.1: Atha kho Kīsā-Gotamiyā bhikkhuniyā etad ahosi || ||
sn5.3:3.2: Ko nu khvāyaṃ manusso vā amanusso vā gāthaṃ abhāsīti || || 5.
sn5.3:3.3: Atha kho Kisā-Gotamiyā bhikkhuniyā etad ahosi || ||
sn5.3:3.4: Māro kho ayaṃ pāpimā mama bhayaṃ chambhitattam lomahaṃsam uppādetu-kāmo samādhimhā cāvetu-kāmo gāthaṃ bhāsatīti || || 6.
sn5.3:4.1: Atha kho Kisā-Gotamī bhikkhunī Māro kho ayam pāpimā iti viditvā Māram pāpimantam gāthāhi paccābhāsi || ||
sn5.3:7.1: Atha kho Māro pāpimā || jānāti maṃ Kisā-Gotamī bhikkhunīti dukkhī dummano tatth-ev-antaradhāyīti || || 1. Sāvatthi nidānaṃ || ||
